title: Harness overlay verbs never re-derive rc.view.scale/off_x after view_set_rail — the world renders at the full-window fit, extending under the rail
evidence:
harness/overlay.odin:76-79:
	rnd.view_set_rail(&rc.view, true)
	rl.BeginDrawing()
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, &state.topology, &state.bundles, &state.flow, &state.crisis, sim_tick, {}, -1, -1, state.seed)
	rnd.draw_noc_overlay(&rc.view, &feed, &stats, &state.topology, &state.bundles, cat, state.events[:], -1, u32(len(state.flow.packets)), 0)
app/render/view.odin view_set_rail (only mutates play_w, never scale/off):
	view_set_rail :: proc(v: ^View, on: bool) {
		if on {
			v.play_w = v.win_w - NOC_RAIL_W
harness/goldens.odin:89 (the only scale/off derivation, run once before the verb, full-window fit):
	rnd.view_compute(&rc.view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)
detail: view_set_rail mutates only play_w; the harness has no per-frame camera_update to re-derive scale/off_x (the app's healing path). draw_world/map_draw read the stale full-window transform, so the 1040px world renders at scale 720/780 (screen width 960, off_x 160, right edge 1120) — ~364px under the 756..1280 plate. The exported capture is not the app's fit-to-rail frame the new comment claims.
recommended_fix: After view_set_rail in overlay_check and overlay_pixels_check, recompute rc.view.scale = camera_fit(&rc.view) and off_x = f32(play_w)/2 - cam_wx*scale (the camera_set_fit math) before draw_world.

title: Armed upgrade-preview card (variable height, right-anchored at win_w) paints over the rail's content below NOC_CONTENT_Y — no guard for preview+D
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:337:
NOC_CONTENT_Y     :: 116            // the first content row's y (below the top band)
app/render/forecast.odin:104-109 (preview card anchored below the weather card at the window's right edge):
		preview_y := y + hud(v, 6)
		if rows > 0 {
			preview_y = y + title_h + i32(rows) * line_h + pad + hud(v, 6)
		}
		draw_upgrade_preview(v, cat, preview, x, preview_y, card_w, pad, line_h, title_h)
app/render/forecast.odin:155 (height grows with up to MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS=12 shift rows):
	h := title_h + i32(lines) * line_h + pad
app/main.odin:1486-1487 (drawn inside draw_hud, i.e. AFTER the rail at main.odin:718-720):
			rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&app.view, &app.state.crisis, &app.cat, app.state.era, &prev)
detail: NOC_CONTENT_Y=116 assumes the top band ends ~104, but the armed upgrade-preview card starts at y≈60 and grows to ~334px tall at the window's right edge. With a pipe selected + U + D on, it hides the rail's E22 numeral (right-aligned at win_w-18) and the per-class ledger's right columns. No guard disarms or re-anchors the preview while the overlay is on.
recommended_fix: Re-anchor the upgrade-preview card to the playfield (start x from play_w like the crisis banner/settings modal), or skip/gate the preview card while overlay_on.

title: overlay_on with stats_valid false shrinks the playfield but draws zero rail pixels (plate included) until the first stepped tick
detail: After a restart with D still on, stats_valid is false until the first stepped tick, so every frame in between renders the world fitted to the 524px-narrower play_w with no plate drawn — an empty right band flash (~2-3 frames).
recommended_fix: Draw the plate whenever overlay_on (move it out of the stats_valid gate), or defer view_set_rail(true) until the first valid stats record.
